description: Nourishing simplicity, getting back to the details and leading with “show me how great this life can get” #ShowMeHowGoodItCanGet #MayEnergy #IntentionalLiving #SoftAndAligned #TheInnerPour #DivinelyLed #LifeOnPurpose #BlackGirlInBloom #ThisSeasonIsMine #LuxuryInTheLittleThings #livingfully
transcript: Maybe it's spring and summer is coming, or maybe it's delusion, but either way, I am only accepting greatness in the season. I'm only pursuing how great it can be. I'm only pursuing how much life that I can nourish, and for me, that looks like getting out of my comfort zone. That looks like being willing to transition, and it looks like being willing to detach. The more that I detach and let go of control, the more I allow space and opportunity for new doors to open, and new opportunities to present themselves without me having to chase them. So the theme for this season is, show me how great it can get.
